source_text: Qui sedent super cathedram Moysi omnia opera sua faciunt ut ab hominibus videantur. Onus legis corporale grave est; jugum Christi suave et onus leve — Evangelium lex spiritalis. Claudunt regnum caelorum nec ipsi intrant nec alios introire sinunt. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Who sit upon chair of Moses all works their they-do that by humans they-may-be-seen. Burden of-law bodily heavy is; yoke of-Christ sweet and burden light — Gospel law spiritual. They-shut kingdom of-heavens neither themselves enter nor others to-enter they-allow. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Those who [[sit on Moses’ seat >> Bible:Matthew 23:2]] do all their works [[to be seen by people >> Bible:Matthew 23:5]]. The bodily law’s burden is heavy; Christ’s [[yoke is easy and his burden light >> Bible:Matthew 11:30]] — the Gospel as spiritual law. They [[shut the kingdom of the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 23:13]], neither entering nor letting others in. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
